木块向右滑，地面对它的滑动摩擦力向左，木块便慢下来。三条路上木块一样、开始一样快: The block slides right while friction from the surface acts left, slowing it down. The blocks and starting speeds are the same, but different contacting materials lead to different stopping places.
鞋底和地面的摩擦帮助我们走路而不打滑。摩擦不是只会“捣乱”。搓一搓手会变暖，也能: Friction between shoes and the ground helps us walk without slipping. It is useful too. Rubbing your hands warms them, giving a clue that motion energy can become thermal energy.
把三块木头都送回起点。慢慢推进时间，看谁先停下。再只增加出发速度：同一条路上的木: Return all three blocks to the start. Advance time slowly and see which stops first. Then increase only the starting speed: does the block slide farther on the same surface?
本页模拟水平地面上的滑动木块，松手后不再施力。用近似动摩擦模型 F = μmg，: These blocks slide on level ground with no continued push. The approximate kinetic-friction model F = μmg gives deceleration μg and stopping distance d = v₀²/(2μg). Blocks do not reverse after stopping. The three illustrative coefficients are 0.12, 0.28 and 0.50, not measured material data. Real friction depends on both materials, surface condition and contact; visible roughness alone does not determine it.
这里使用没有轮子的滑动玩具，不能把结果直接当成小汽车的滚动距离。省略空气阻力、表: The toys slide without wheels, so these results do not directly describe rolling toy cars. Air resistance, surface deformation and starting static friction are omitted. Time is in seconds and all lanes use the same visual scale. Material names identify these illustrative scenarios; real wood, cloth and sandpaper need not always rank this way.

两个接触处，摩擦做着不同的事: Two contacts, two different roles for friction
正常制动且轮胎未滑时：路面静摩擦给车辆向后的外力，刹车片与盘的滑动摩擦给车轮制动: During braking without tire slip, static road friction gives the vehicle a backward external force; sliding pad–disc friction supplies braking torque to the wheel.

运动、摩擦与停下来: Motion, friction and coming to a stop
木块停下，车轮慢下来，人也要一起慢下来。沿着“谁在施力、运动能量去了哪里”这条线: Blocks stop, wheels slow, and people must slow too. Follow who exerts the force and where motion energy goes through contact, braking and protection.
初始平动能量在运动与已转移部分之间的分配: Initial translational energy divided between remaining motion and transferred energy
轮子向前，不等于接地点在滑: A moving wheel need not slide at its contact
先看同一个金色胎面标记。正常滚动时，它接地的那一瞬间相对地面不滑动；锁止轮仍可能: Follow the same gold tread mark. In rolling, it is momentarily at rest relative to the road when it touches. A locked wheel can still slide forward as a whole. This diagram isolates contact motion rather than calculating braking distance.
同一个车轮向右移动；金点追踪胎面，绿色短线标记接地区，蓝色箭头只在接触处滑动时出: The same wheel moves right. Gold follows the tread, green marks the contact region, and the blue arrow appears only when that contact slides.
金点不是一直贴着地面的那个接触点。轮胎尺寸和位移是示意；播放是观察时钟，不与下一: The gold mark does not stay at the ground contact. Wheel size and displacement are illustrative; playback is an observation clock, not the stopping seconds in the next chapter.
进一步区分：力传到哪里，能量在哪里变化？: Look deeper: where does force act, and where does energy change?
刹车盘随轮子转动，刹车片与盘面相对滑动，摩擦产生制动力矩并把机械能转为内能。轮胎: The disc rotates with the wheel while the pad slides relative to it, supplying braking torque and converting mechanical energy to internal energy. With ideal no-slip tire contact, static road friction transmits external force; forward vehicle motion does not imply continuous rubbing there. The instantaneous no-slip contact point is at rest on an ideal stationary road, so this is not the same local heating process as pad friction.
现实轮胎存在形变、滚动阻力与局部滑移，刹车也可能有再生制动。这一对照只解释运动约: Real tires deform and involve rolling resistance and local slip; braking may also recover energy. This comparison explains kinematic constraints, not ABS control or locked-wheel stopping distance. Friction does not always oppose forward motion: a driven wheel can use road friction to accelerate.
